elena: Quick thread 0min: I opened PR #912 to unify glossary slugs and add migration snippets. Main Qs: canonical slugs, alias field, and where to host legacy SDK examples. Can we decide?

matt: My vote: canonical slug = descriptive short (kebab-case), e.g., redwood-private. Add aliases array for search.

viv: For migration docs, include both legacy and new snippets side-by-side. Customers search for old function names. Keep voice direct and procedural.

sam: I fixed two broken links in PR and added a small retry callout for Dedicated examples. link-bot: Linkcheck: 0 errors after latest commit.

elena: Great. Action: sam will land retry note, matt will add alias metadata, viv will add legacy snippets. I'll merge after a final read. :thumbsup:
